# Sinton Ace Hardware

> A locally owned Ace Hardware store in Sinton, Texas, serving San Patricio
> County. Hardware, paint, tools, plumbing, electrical, lawn and garden,
> housewares and sporting goods, plus in-store repair and cutting services.
> Previously operated as Sinton's True Value; it is now an Ace Hardware
> retailer and no longer carries True Value products.

## Contact
Address: 105 W Sinton St, Sinton, TX 78387
Phone: (361) 364-4636
Website: https://acesinton.com/
Shop online for in-store pickup: https://www.acehardware.com/store-details/19238

## Hours
Monday - Friday: 7:30 AM - 5:00 PM
Saturday: 8:00 AM - 12:00 PM
Sunday: Closed

### Holiday exceptions
Thursday, November 26, 2026 (Thanksgiving): Closed
Thursday, December 24, 2026 (Christmas Eve): 7:30 AM - 12:00 PM
Friday, December 25, 2026 (Christmas Day): Closed
Friday, January 1, 2027 (New Year's Day): Closed
All other days, including the day after Thanksgiving, December 26 and
December 31, are regular hours.

## Services
- Paint color matching
- Key cutting
- Small engine repair - STIHL, ECHO, EGO and other small-engine equipment.
  All repair work is done in-store at hourly rates. Nothing is sent out.
  The store does not perform manufacturer warranty work.
- Window and door screen repair, plus custom-built screens
- Glass cutting
Repair labor, screens and glass cutting are quoted by the store's service
technician.

## Departments
Paint and sundries, hardware, plumbing, electrical, hand and power tools,
automotive, lawn and garden, garden place, patio and outdoor living,
housewares, cleaning supplies, clothing, sporting goods, gift shop.

## Brands carried
STIHL, ECHO, EGO, DeWALT, Milwaukee, YETI, Traeger, Weber, Blackstone,
Benjamin Moore. The store has been a STIHL dealer since July 2026.

## Good to know
- In-store retail pricing matches acehardware.com.
- Online orders placed on acehardware.com can be picked up at the store.
- Ace Rewards members earn on purchases; sign-up is available at checkout.
- Ace gift cards are sold in store.
- Payment is taken in store. The store does not accept payment over the phone.
- Returns require a receipt.
- The store does not sell propane, does not sell lumber or wood, and no longer
  rents carpet cleaners.

## Where we are
Sinton is the county seat of San Patricio County on the Texas Coastal Bend.
Nearby communities include Odem, Edroy, Taft, Gregory, Portland and Mathis.
